S.title: Match a Fix - Community Builders of Pecan Grove
S.intro1: Before the Town Council decides, it asks neighbors for ideas to fix problems.
S.intro2: Other places already tried some fixes. Match each problem to a fix that helps. Then check: did it work?
S.coach2: Now tap a fix that could help it.
S.coach2Down: Now scroll down to 'Fixes from real places' and tap one that could help it.
S.openChip: No tested fix yet · Tap to share an idea
S.oneOpen: One problem has no tested fix yet. You can share your own idea for it.

S.real: Pick one problem at your school or in your neighborhood. With a grown-up, look for one place that tried a fix. Did it work?
S.guText: Each solution card names a real place and gives an honest 'Did it work?' note, for example testing wells before and after digging, or metering construction water. Some problems, like rent rises, truck traffic and power-line routes, have no tested fix yet.

bank.b0005: Cooling the computers could use lots of drinking water.
bank.b0008: A data center there began cooling with recycled water in 2012.
bank.b0009: Nobody counts the water used while building.
bank.b0010: Put a meter on every water pipe
bank.b0012: Some pipes were missed at first. Once found, the water was paid for.
bank.b0013: The computers make lots of heat that goes to waste.
bank.b0014: Use the heat to warm homes
bank.b0016: It warms thousands of homes. It works best where a town already has heat pipes.
bank.b0017: Most jobs could go to people from far away.
bank.b0018: Train people who live here for the jobs
bank.b0020: A tech college there teaches the classes. We don't know yet how many got jobs.
bank.b0021: Mud from digging could get into wells.
bank.b0022: Test wells before and after digging
bank.b0024: Neighbors and the company there disagree about what made wells muddy. Testing first helps everyone know.
bank.b0025: Old graves could be hidden on the land.
bank.b0026: Look for graves first and leave space around them
bank.b0028: Hampton kept a 50-foot space around an old graveyard. Other places are still checking.
bank.b0029: Farms and forests could be cleared away.
bank.b0032: In 2026, a proposed deal there would make a project about 20% smaller.
bank.b0033: A low hum could keep neighbors awake.
bank.b0034: Measure sounds before building, then every year
bank.b0036: Chandler started this in 2023. We found no results yet.
bank.b0037: Backup engines could make smoky air.
bank.b0040: Virginia made it a rule for new permits in 2026.
bank.b0041: Bright lights could shine into homes all night.
bank.b0043: Lights were dimmed in 2025 after neighbors asked. Some neighbors still have worries.
bank.b0044: It could be built very close to homes.
bank.b0045: Keep a wide space between it and homes
bank.b0047: South Fulton made this a rule in 2026: 100 to 150 feet of space.
bank.b0048: Power bills could go up for families.
bank.b0049: Big users pay their own share of power costs
bank.b0051: Ohio started this for one power company in 2025. There is little bill data yet.
bank.b0052: Tax breaks could leave less money for schools.
bank.b0053: Pay full taxes, with no tax break
bank.b0055: In 2026, a data center there said it will pay full property taxes.
bank.b0056: If it closes someday, an empty building could be left.
bank.b0057: Set money aside now to remove it later
bank.b0059: Kent County made a rule like this in 2026. It has not been used yet.
bank.b0060: Neighbors might not know who wants to build, or what was promised.
bank.b0064: Neighbors could feel that nobody listens to them.
bank.b0065: A neighbors' group that meets with leaders
bank.b0067: In 2024 the county put more neighbors in its advice group. Results aren't known yet.
bank.b0068: Rents could go up while many workers are in town.
bank.b0070: Ask landlords to keep rents the same for a while
bank.b0071: Bring workers by bus from bigger towns
bank.b0072: Lots of big trucks could crowd the roads for months.
bank.b0073: Trucks drive only when school buses don't
bank.b0074: Make a special road for the trucks
bank.b0075: The builders fix any road the trucks damage
bank.b0076: New power lines could cross people's land.
bank.b0077: Follow power lines that are already there
bank.b0079: Ask landowners early where lines could go
